spec_scope: Named MY trims only; selectable references, not automatic equipment certification. Empty trim lists do not invent a Standard trim. Special editions require vehicle confirmation.
engine_scope: Engine size in litres; no inferred exact displacement_cc, no automatic fuel, drive or feature assignment.
reference_year_policy: Year options include explicitly named model years, dated Malaysian launch or price-list snapshots, and identified manufactured-year records. Each added row states its evidence basis. These are selectable references, not proof that every car manufactured in that year has those specifications; no adjacent-year availability is inferred.
